spots.name: Església de Sant Esteve
spots.summary: Església de Sant Esteve is a Roman Catholic church located on Plaça del Príncep Benlloch in Andorra la Vella, Andorra. It is a heritage property registered in the Cultural Heritage of Andorra.

spots.name: Casa de la Vall
spots.summary: Casa de la Vall is a historical house in Andorra la Vella, Andorra. It was the seat of the General Council of Andorra until 2011. It lies just to the southwest of the Andorra National Library. It is a heritage property registered in the Cultural Heritage of Andorra.

spots.name: Church of Santa Coloma d'Andorra

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of Santa Coloma d'Andorra is a church in Santa Coloma, Andorra la Vella Parish, Andorra, and is Andorra's oldest church. It is a heritage property registered in the Cultural Heritage of Andorra. It is dedicated to Columba of Sens, patron saint of Andorra.

spots.name: Andorra National Library

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Andorra National Library was founded in 1930, then re-opened in 1974. Since 2020, it is housed in the former Hotel Rosaleda in Encamp.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Església de Sant Pere Màrtir, Escaldes-Engordany is a church located in Escaldes–Engordany, Andorra, that was constructed from 1956 to 1981. It is a heritage property registered in the Cultural Heritage of Andorra. The funeral of Antoni Martí, former prime minister of Andorra, was conducted in this church.

spots.summary: Església de Sant Corneli i Sant Cebrià d'Ordino is a church located in Ordino, Andorra. spots.name: L'Escenari de pizzes
spots.summary: The pizzas are very good, especially the signature ones; you can see how they are making it. Friendly treatment. Cozy place. It is run by some Argentines. It is tiny, it has 4 tables so it is essential to book on Friday and Saturday.

spots.name: The Cellar Door
spots.summary: This wine and alcohol shop does wine tastings, including of Andorran wines, which you will otherwise get only at the wineries (€4 a tasting, €8 a glass, €45-50 per bottle).

spots.name: Marisqueria Don Denis
spots.summary: A Mediterranean restaurant with local cuisine. The restaurant also has a wall of photos of "who's who" celebrities, politicians and dignitaries eating at the restaurant.

spots.name: Pizzeria La Piazza
spots.summary: The pizzas and hamburgers are great. Attentive and friendly service. It is somewhat hidden from the shopping area. Dine-in or delivery. Order or reserve online.

spots.name: Bar Els Manyos

spots.summary: Small and popular with locals, this restaurant is a great place to try some local cuisine, including escudella. The food is rustic and portions are generous.

spots.name: L'arroseria
spots.summary: Spectacular black rice. The place is very cozy. The attention is great. Warm welcome. A little hidden, small room (remember to book).

spots.name: L'Alternativa
spots.summary: Perfect place to dine or have some tapas. Homemade food. A cool place. The whole team is professional, attentive and friendly.

spots.name: Restaurant les Closes
spots.summary: Very nice place. They have a wide variety of food. They serve you quickly. The staff polite and efficient.
